/dpal bka' 'dus kyi lha dbang bkol byang bzhugs so/1hūm̐:dbus phyogs dkyil 'khor chen po'i lte ba nas:gdod ma'i mgon po zhi ba kun tu 'chang :'bar ba

tei:div.tei:p: ¿ /dpal bka' 'dus kyi lha dbang bkol byang bzhugs so/ 1 hūm̐: dbus phyogs dkyil 'khor chen po'i lte ba nas: gdod ma'i mgon po zhi ba kun tu 'chang : 'bar ba'i skur bzhengs spyi dpal che ba'i mchog: sku mdog smug nag dbu ni nyi shu gcig: phyogs rer zhal lnga mthing dkar ljang dang dmar: gtsug gi zhal gcig mthing nag nam mkha'i mdangs: zhal dang mtshungs pa'i yan lag bzhi bcu dang : rtsa ba'i phyag gnyis mthing ga rdor dril bsnams: lhag ma g.yas rnams phyogs bcu'i sangs rgyas dang : g.yon rnams phyogs bcu'i byang sems yab yum rnams: nyi shu rtsa bzhi zhabs kyi dor stabs kyis: phyogs skyong zhing skyong rgyal chen gdan du brdzis: dur khrod dpal chas rus pa'i rgyan gyis brgyan: gnyis med yum chen kun tu bskyod ma ni: dmar nag gri gug thod phrag 'dzin pas 'khyud: yab yum zung 'jug bde stong rol pa las: nyi ma dang ni 'od zer ji bzhin du: spyi dpal lha tshogs drug brgya drug cu bzhi: sku mdog phyag mtshan rnam 'gyur ma 'dres pa: gang 'dul 'gro ba'i dpal du lham mer gsal: skal ldan rigs kyi bu la dbang bskur bas: spyi dpal lha tshogs yongs rdzogs dbang thob shog: oṃ badz+ra ma hā shrī he ru ka sarba kro dha hūm̐ phaṭa: kā ya a bhi ṣiñtsa oṃ: 2 hūm̐: shar stod byams pa'i pho brang lte ba nas: yang dag mthing nag zhal gsum phyag drug pa: g.yas dkar g.yon dmar dbus mthing zhabs bzhi bgrad: g.yas gsum rdo rje kha ṭ+wām̐ rnge'u chung : g.yon gsum zhing dbyug dung dmar rgyu zhags gdengs: kro dhī shwa ri gri thod 'dzin pas 'khyud: drug cu rtsa brgyad dkyil 'khor lhun gyis grub: skal ldan rigs kyi bu la dbang bskur bas: yang dag lha tshogs yongs rdzogs dbang thob shog: oṃ ru lu ru lu hūm̐ bh+yo hūm̐ phaṭa: kā ya a bhi ṣiñtsa oṃ: 3 hūm̐: shar sribs snying rje'i pho brang lte ba nas: rdo rje phreng ba dmar nag dkar ba'i zhal:

phyag drug rdo rje me phung mgo phreng g.yas: dril bu pad+ma glegs baṃ g.yon na bsnams: snang dbyings dmar mo gri thod 'dzin pas 'khyud: brgya dang rtsa brgyad sprul pa'i 'khor lor bzhengs: skal ldan rigs kyi bu ladabang bskur bas: phreng ba'i lha tshogs yongs rdzogs dbang thob shog: oṃ badz+ra mā la dhe ba ga ṇa hūm̐ pha¿ṭa: kā ya a bhi ṣiñtsa oṃ: hūm̐: shar dbus dga' ba'i pho brang lte ba nas: phyag na rdo rje mthing dkar ljang ba'i zhal: phyag drug rgya gram phreng ba ral gri g.yas: thod khrag sdigs mdzub sbrul zhags g.yon na bsnams: khams gsum dbang sdud dmar mo yab la 'khril: dbu gsum phyag drug gri gug baṃ dbyug g.yas: bhan dmar dril bu sbrul zhags g.yon gyis 'khyud: lha tshogs brgyad cu'i 'khor lo spro zhing bsdu: skal ldan rigs kyi bu la dbang bskur bas: phyag rdor lha tshogs yongs rdzogs dbang thob shog: oṃ badz+ra pā ṇi nī laṃ bā ra hūm̐ phaṭa: kā ya a bhi ṣiñtsa oṃ: 5 hūm̐: shar smad btang snyoms pho brang lte ba nas: rdo rje rtsal rdzogs mthing dkar ljang ba'i zhal: phyag drug rdo rje dgra s+t+wa lcags kyu g.yas: dril bu mi mgo tsit+ta g.yon na bsnams: rdo rje bde ma gri thod 'dzin pa dmar: mnyam sbyor sum cu rtsa drug lha tshogs shar: skal ldan rigs kyi bu la dbang bskur bas: rdo rje rtsal rdzogs yongs rdzogs dbang thob shog: oṃ badz+ra dhū sha ti kiṃ rū pa kā ya kro dhī hūm̐ phaṭa: kā ya a bhi ṣiñtsa oṃ: 6 hūm̐: lho stod sbyin pa'i pho brang lte ba nas: rdo rje thod phreng dmar smug dkar ser zhal: phyag drug rtse lnga rtse dgu rgya gram g.yas: gser zangs lcags kyi sdig pa g.yon na gzir: sbyor yum dmar mo gri thod 'dzin pas 'khyud: rig 'dzin mkha' 'gro brgyad cu'i 'khor gyis bskor: skal ldan rigs kyi bu la dbang bskur bas: rig 'dzin lha tshogs yongs rdzogs dbang thob shog:

oṃ badz+ra ku la dhā ra gu ru dhe wa dhā ki nī sarba hūm̐ phaṭa: kā ya a bhi ṣiñtsa oṃ: 7 hūm̐: lho sribs ngag snyan smra ba'i pho brang nas: bde mchog 'khor lo rtsa zhal mthing ka la: g.yon ljang rgyab dmar g.yas ser phyag bcu gnyis: dang po gnyis kyis rdor dril yum la 'khyud: tha ma gnyis kyis glang ko brgyangs te 'dzin: lhag ma cang te dgra s+t+wa gri gug dang : rtse gsum dbyug pa g.yas la kha ṭ+wāṃ ga: thod dbyug bhan dmar tshangs mgo g.yon na gdengs: rnal 'byor dmar mo gri thod 'dzin pas 'khyud: drug cu rtsa gnyis bde stong chen por rdzogs: skal ldan rigs kyi bu la dbang bskur bas: bde mchog lha tshogs yongs rdzogs dbang thob shog: oṃ shrī badz+ra he he ru ru kaṃ dhā ki ni dz+wa la sam+bā raṃ hrīḥha ha hūm̐ hūm̐ pha¿ṭa: kā ya a bhi ṣiñtsa oṃ: 8 hūm̐: lho dkyil don mthun pho brang lte ba nas: gshin rje mthing nag mthing dkar dmar ba'i zhal: g.yas gsum thod dbyug dgra s+t+wa ral gri dang : g.yon gsum zhags pa mdung thung thod khrag bsnams: za byed dgra s+t+wa dung dmar stob pa 'khril: drug cu rtsa lnga'i sprul pas dgra bgegs 'dul: skal ldan rigs kyi bu la dbang bskur bas: gshin rje'i lha tshogs yongs rdzogs dbang thob shog: oṃ a kro te ka ya mān+ta ka ha na ma tha bhañtsa hūm̐ phaṭa: kā ya a bhi ṣiñtsa oṃ: 8 hūm̐: lho smad don spyod pho brang lte ba nas: rat+na rtsal rdzogs ser nag dmar ba'i zhal: be con ral gri srid pa 'khor lo g.yas: sbrul zhags phubs dang bhan dmar g.yon na 'dzin: sbyor yum dmar nag be con bhan 'dzin 'khyud: lnga bcu rtsa lnga'i dkyil 'khor yongs su rdzogs: skal ldan rigs kyi bu la dbang bskur bas: rat+na rtsal rdzogs yongs rdzogs dbang thob shog: oṃ rat+na dhū sha ti rū pa kā ya hūm̐ phaṭa: kā ya a bhi ṣiñtsa oṃ: 10 hūm̐: nub stod 'dod pa zag med lte ba nas: rta mgrin dmar nag dmar dkar sngo ba'i zhal:

phyag drug kha ṭ+wāṃ rdo rje sbrul zhags g.yas: dril bu bhan dmar lcags sgrogs g.yon na bsnams: dbu gtsug rta mgo ljang zhur rta skad mtsher: ral gcig kha ṭ+wāṃ thod khrag stob pas 'khril: lnga bcu rtsa lnga'i lha tshogs gzi byin 'bar: skal ldan rigs kyi bu la dbang bskur bas: rta mgrin lha tshogs yongs rdzogs dbang thob shog: oṃ hrīḥpad+man+ta kṛ ta ma hā kro dha ha ya gṝ ba hūm̐ pha¿ṭa: kā ya a bhi ṣiñtsa oṃ: 11 hūm̐: nub sribs ma rig zag med lte ba nas: kye yi rdo rje zhal brgyad bcu drug phyag: g.yas dkar g.yon sngo mdun rgyab nyi ma'i mdog: g.yas brgyad rdo rje thod phreng sbyor yum 'khyud: g.yon brgyad bhan dmar kha ṭ+wāṃ sgrol yum 'khyud: bdag med rdo rje gri thod 'dzin dang sbyor: drug cu rtsa lnga'i dkyil 'khor 'od zer 'phro: skal ldan rigs kyi bu la dbang bskur bas: dgyes rdor lha tshogs yongs rdzogs dbang thob shog: oṃ de ba pi tsu badz+ra dhā ki ni hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭa swā hā: kā ya a bhi ṣiñtsa oṃ: 12 hūm̐: nub dkyil sred pa zag med lte ba nas: gsang 'dus zhal lnga phyag bcu rtsa zhal mthing : g.yas dkar g.yon nag rgyab mthing spyi gtsug dmar: g.yas lnga rdo rje nyi ma'i rgyal mtshan dang : g.yon lnga dril bu nyi zla'i phreng ba 'dzin: mkha' spyod tsit+ta bhan dmar stob pas 'khril: lha tshogs brgya dang sum cu'i tshom bur rdzogs: skal ldan rigs kyi bu la dbang bskur bas: gsang 'dus lha tshogs yongs rdzogs dbang thob shog: oṃ ma hā shrī gu h+ya sa mā dza kro dhā rā dza a dhi pa ti hūm̐ phaṭa: kā ya a bhi ṣiñtsa oṃ: 13 hūm̐:nub smad lta ba zag med pho brang dbus: pad+ma rtsal rdzogs dmar smug dkar sngo'i zhal: phyag drug mda' dar thod dbyug me phung g.yas: shel bum zla nyi dpal be g.yon na bsnams: 'od dkor khro mo tshe bum bsnams pas 'khril: dgu bcu rtsa brgyad lha tshogs yongs su rdzogs:

skal ldan rigs kyi bu la dbang bskur bas: pad+ma rtsal rdzogs yongs rdzogs dbang thob shog: oṃ pad+ma dhu sha ti ā yur bhan+dha tshe bh+rūm̐ yu bh+rūm̐ ā yu ṣe bh+rūm̐ swā hā: kā ya a bhi ṣiñtsa oṃ: 14 hūm̐: byang stod chos kun stong nyid lte ba nas: che mchog dbu dgu bco brgyad phyag dang ldan: dbus gsum mthing nag g.yas gsum dkar ser zhal: g.yon gsum dmar nag zhabs brgyad phyogs mtshams bgrad: g.yas dgu rdo rje g.yon dgu bhan+dha bsnams: kro dhī shwa ri gri thod 'dzin pas 'khyud: yon tan lha tshogs bdun cu rtsa gnyis spro: skal ldan rigs kyi bu la dbang bskur bas: che mchog lha tshogs yongs rdzogs dbang thob shog: oṃ shrī ma hā nā yā ya he ru ka hūm̐ phaṭa: kā ya a bhi ṣiñtsa oṃ: 15 hūm̐: byang sribs mtshan med dkyil 'khor lte ba nas: dus kyi 'khor lo mthing nag rtsa zhal gnag: g.yon dkar rgyab ser g.yas pa dkar ba'i zhal: phyag g.yas bcu gnyis rdo rje 'khor lo dang : rin chen pad+ma rgya gram ral gri phreng : me long spos me snang gsal dri chab 'dzin: g.yon na dril bu thod pa rin chen sgrom: gseg par pi waṃ pusti go cha dang : mi mgo sbrul zhags mda' gzhu dgra s+t+wa gshol: dz+nyā na swa ra gri thod 'dzin pas 'khyud: brgya dang drug cu rtsa bzh-i'i lha tshogs shar: skal ldan rigs kyi bu la dbang bskur bas: dus 'khor lha tshogs yongs rdzogs dbang thob shog: oṃ na mo bha ga wa tī kā la tsakrā ya hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭa: kā ya a bhi ṣiñtsa oṃ: 16 hūm̐: byang dkyil smon pa med pa'i lte ba nas: mkha' klong 'khyil ba dmar mthing ljang ba'i zhal: dgos 'byung bsam 'phel yid bzhin nor bu g.yas: nam mkha' rgya mtsho sa gzhi'i mdzod gsum g.yon: rang 'dra'i sbyor yum u tsuṣ+mā dang 'khril: nor lha brgya dang bcu bdun tshom bur rdzogs: skal ldan rigs kyi bu la dbang bskur bas: mkha' klong lha tshogs yongs rdzogs dbang thob shog:

oṃ ke gu pa yam̐ rat+na bā su de sha ke bh+yo hūm̐ hūm̐ pha¿ṭa/ kā ya a bhi ṣiñtsa oṃ: 17 hūm̐:byang smad mngon par 'du mi byed pa'i dbus: karma rtsal rdzogs ser ljang dmar ba'i zhal: g.yas gsum ral gri lcags kyu me phung gdengs: g.yon gsum lha khang glegs bam 'ja' tshon 'dzin: yum chen zil gnon rin chen bhan 'dzin 'khyud: brgya dang lnga bcu'i lha tshogs lhun gyis grub: skal ldan rigs kyi bu la dbang bskur bas: karma rtsal rdzogs yongs rdzogs dbang thob shog: oṃ karma kro dha dhu sha ti tiṣ+ṭha sid+dhi ā he ru ka hūm̐ pha¿ṭa: kā ya a bhi ṣiñtsa oṃ: 18 hūm̐: shar lho lus dran nyer bzhag dkyil 'khor dbus: mngon rdzogs rgyal po mthing dkar dmar ba'i zhal: rdo rje khyung dang sbrul zhags g.yas na bsnams: bhan+dha zhing g.yab ga'u g.yon na 'dzin: nyid zhi mu kha bde stong thig ler sbyor: srid pa ma mo bdun cu rtsa bzhir rdzogs: skal ldan rigs kyi bu la dbang bskur bas: srid pa ma mo yongs rdzogs dbang thob shog: oṃ gu h+ya dhā tu ā kar+ṣa ma hā pa ta ye he ru ka hūm̐ pha¿ṭa: kā ya a bhi ṣiñtsa oṃ: 19 hūm̐: lho nub tshor dran nyer gzhag dkyil 'khor dbus: rdo rje gzhon nu mthing dkar dmar ba'i zhal: phyag drug g.yas gnyis rdo rje rtse dgu lnga: g.yon gnyis me phung kha ṭ+wām̐ tha ma gnyis: srid pa phur bur 'dril zhing sbyor ba'i yum: rgyas 'debs mthing nag kha ṭ+wām̐ thod pa 'dzin: phrin las lha tshogs brgyad cu rtsa bzhi 'phro: skal ldan rigs kyi bu la dbang bskur bas: phur pa'i lha tshogs yongs rdzogs dbang thob shog: oṃ badz+ra kī li kī lā ya sarba bigh+nān bam̐ hūm̐ phaṭa: kā ya a bhi ṣiñtsa oṃ: 20 hūm̐: nub byang sems dran nyer gzhag dkyil 'khor dbus: dregs 'dul mthing nag mthing ser smug nag zhal: rdo rje lha brgyad mgo bo g.yas na bsnams: thod khrag klu brgyad mgo bo g.yon na 'dzin:

khams gsum spyi 'dul rdo rje bhan 'dzin 'khyud: dregs pa'i lha tshogs bzhi bcu rngams shing rol: skal ldan rigs kyi bu la dbang bskur bas: dregs 'dul lha tshogs yongs rdzogs dbang thob shog: oṃ badz+ra kro dha de ba tsaṇ+ḍa bhe ra ba sarba duṣ+tan e dzaḥ bh+yo hūm̐ pha¿ṭa: kā ya a bhi ṣiñtsa oṃ: 21 hūm̐: byang shar chos dran nyer gzhag dkyil 'khor dbus: stobs ldan nag po mthing nag drag po'i zhal: rdo rje lha brgyad tsit+ta g.yas na bsnams: bhan dmar klu brgyad tsit+ta g.yon na 'dzin: 'byung lnga'i bdag mo g.yas pas nam mkha' 'degs: g.yon pas sa gzhi gnon cing yab dang 'khril: drag sngags lha tshogs nyi shu rtsa brgyad 'bar: skal ldan rigs kyi bu la dbang bskur bas: drag sngags lha tshogs yongs rdzogs dbang thob shog: oṃ badz+ra dz+wa la man+t+ra sarba duṣ+tan bhan+dha hūm̐ pha¿ṭa: kā ya a bhi ṣiñtsa oṃ: zhes gu ru o rgyan gling pa'i zab gter dpal bka' 'dus kyi snying po don gyi dbang bzhi'i skabs/ spro na dkyil 'khor lha tshogs gtso btus kyi dbang bskur zhes gsungs pa'i bsgrags tshig mngon rtogs las kha bsgyur ba'i lha dbang gi bkol byang le'u tshan no/ /maṅga laṃ// //
